title: Give any text agent a phone number (example: a company's internal assistant)

steps.text: Companies now build text agents for everything: support, sales, internal knowledge. They all live in a chat window.
Take one example. Acme, a payments company, has an internal assistant called Atlas. Employees type questions, and it answers from the company's docs, tickets and dashboards.
But Acme's people often need answers away from a screen. Driving to a customer, or walking into a meeting.
Giving an agent a phone is a second product: speech, phone numbers, checking who's calling. That's weeks of work, for every agent.
And a simple voice wrapper just reads the agent's answer aloud, citations and all.

Here's what I found. Northwind Retail. Renewal date, March twelfth. Source one, open bracket, C R M slash accounts slash northwind dash retail, close bracket. Open tickets, three. Ticket four four eight one two.
{{product}} gives any text agent a real voice, and a phone number.
It sits between people and their agents. It listens, keeps answers short, asks before it acts, and calls back when there's news.
With {{product}}, any text agent gets a voice and a phone number with three lines of code. For Atlas, that's all Acme's developers add. Atlas doesn't change.
{{product}} reads what the agent can do, checks who's calling, and speaks for it. Now anyone at Acme can call Atlas.
Hi Atlas. I'm meeting Northwind Retail in twenty minutes. Anything I should know?

Three things. Their contract renews in March. They have one open issue: settlements have been a day late since last Tuesday. And their payment volume is up eighteen percent this quarter. Want details on the delay?
Yes. Is it fixed?
Not yet. The fix ships Thursday, and no money was lost. Their contact, Dan, was told on Friday.
Okay. Can you get me their volume by region? I want it for the meeting.
That needs a fresh query on the dashboards. It takes a minute or two. I'll call you back.
Hi Megan, it's Atlas. West is up thirty-one percent, and it's driving most of the growth. The other regions are flat. I've texted you the chart and the sources.
Perfect. Thanks!
Same agent, same code. Atlas is just one example. A support agent, a sales agent, any text agent can get a phone the same way.
Your agent, on the line.
